topic: This week in AI: a bug at OpenAI, Gemini 4 Argon, Character.AI's bankruptcy, the IMF's warning, CoreWeave's slide
post:
This was the week AI got a reality check. 🧾
Here are the 5 stories worth your time, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ A hidden bug at OpenAI
The FBI arrested an OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room. OpenAI says it has no sign that model weights, code or customer data were taken.

2️⃣ Gemini 4 Argon goes wide
Google opened its new model to developers and businesses through its API, plus paid Gemini app subscribers. Free tiers are left out for now.

3️⃣ Character.AI files for bankruptcy
The chatbot startup filed for Chapter 11, with Disney as the opening $20M bidder for a license to some of its IP.

4️⃣ The IMF's AI warning
Its new stability report names an AI-driven market correction as one of three near-term risks.

5️⃣ CoreWeave's rough week
The AI cloud company's shares fell about 15% in a day as its bond yields neared 15%, on worries about AI borrowing.

Why it matters:
The tech keeps getting better, but the money side is getting tested. Security, debt and business models matter as much as benchmarks now. 🔍

Practical takeaway:
If you're picking AI tools for your team, look at the company behind the tool, not just the demo. 🧠

Which story surprised you most? 👇
